reading: A judge has declared a mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy murder case.
The jury could not agree after discussing the case for a week.
The case concerns the deaths of her three children.
Her lawyer tried to stop the mistrial, but the attempt failed.
Another court meeting is planned for later in the month.

vocabulary.definition: a trial that ends without a valid final decision
a group of people who decide facts in a trial
a person who leads a court and makes legal decisions
a person trained to help with legal matters
